NONE: › a type of modern art that uses patterns that do not exist naturally in order to create images that appear to move or to be something that they are not
歐普藝術，光效應藝術，視幻藝術（一種利用實際上不存在的圖形使人產生視錯覺的現代藝術）
› used to describe a piece of writing which expresses a personal opinion and is usually printed in a newspaper opposite the page on which the editorial is printed
（指文章）發表個人意見的，專欄版的，特稿的（通常刊在與社論版相對的版面上）
› used by writers to avoid repeating the details of a book or article that has already been referred to, when all the details other than the page number are the same
（用於避免重複前文提到的書或文章的細節）同上，同前文所引

example: Johnson (op. cit., page 53) calls this phenomenon "the principle of minimal effort".
約翰遜（同上，第53頁）把這種現象稱為「最小努力原則」。
